primarySource.location: de Smit-Lenstra, Explicit Construction of Universal Deformation Rings, Proposition 2.6 and section 4
primarySource.relevance: The proof uses the closed trace algebra, residual matrix spanning, the trace pairing and idempotent lifting to descend the representation. Closed subalgebras of a Noetherian complete local ring need not themselves be Noetherian.

ownDrafts.ClosedCoefficientSubalgebraLocality: Use original residue constants and convergent finite geometric sums to put each actual ambient unit inverse in the same closed subalgebra. Then derive unit reflection and locality. No ambient completeness is needed in this lemma.
ownDrafts.CoefficientSubalgebraResidue: Actual coefficient constants give surjectivity of the induced map on true residue fields. Injectivity comes from its field homomorphism. Construct the genuine original residue equivalence and whole reduction identity without assuming the inclusion is surjective.
ownDrafts.ClosedMatrixTraceAlgebra: Construct the actual closed coefficient algebra generated by all whole-representation traces. Continuous coefficient maps that give strictly conjugate representations agree there by actual trace invariance and closure of their equalizer.
ownDrafts.IdempotentNewtonStep: Prove exact noncommutative polynomial identities for 3x^2-2x^3. Convergence and the actual lifted idempotent remain separate obligations.

laterOwnConstructionToProve: Consume the original universal whole framed representation and actual closed trace algebra; derive its locality and true original residue using the new helpers.
Use existing residual absolute irreducibility and local matrix spanning. Extract a basis from the actual original representation matrices using the pinned local finite-presentation/flatness lemma.

Prove perfection of the actual full-matrix trace pairing and unit determinant of its Gram matrix in the original matrix basis. Reflect that unit into the closed trace algebra. Use actual trace coordinates to descend the generated matrix algebra.
Prove closedness of the descended finite matrix algebra, converge the actual idempotent-improvement iteration, and construct the actual rank-n left ideal and a residue-identity change of basis.
Prove the conjugated whole representation takes coefficients in the original closed trace algebra and retains continuity and actual residue.

Own proposed Noetherian descent: use the already constructed framed universality with the conjugated representation over the original ambient ring to obtain an endomorphism. Prove its image lies in the trace algebra using original coordinate generation and density. Prove it fixes that algebra by traces and continuity. Only then identify the trace algebra as a quotient of the Noetherian ambient ring and derive Noetherianness and the required complete local topology.
Construct and prove the actual unframed universal property; trace uniqueness is only one ingredient.
reuseBoundary: Existing actual framed universal coefficient rings, fixed determinant/inertia quotient, residue and adic proofs remain canonical. No external Lean code imported. The Noetherian image/retraction route is an unproved own adaptation, not a theorem asserted from the source.
sourceBoundary: DUB-17-20 remain OPEN. Unframed prorepresentability, modular Galois association, exceptional local conditions, Selmer duality and patching are not proved by these drafts. No change to source hypotheses or proof resources.
